newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian mark Eurobond roadshow week of March 10.
newsitem.headline: Russian mark Eurobond roadshow week of March 10.

text.p: Presentations to analysts for Russia's planned mark Eurobond will take place in the week from March 10, with the Eurobond likely to follow at the end of the week, co-lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Friday.
"We're looking at holding presentations in Frankfurt and Zurich in the week beginning March 10," it said in a statement.
Deutsche Bank management board member Georg Krupp said earlier the roadshow would be held at the beginning of next week and the Eurobond probably issud at the end of next week.
But officials at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking division of Deutsche, said Krupp had meant the following week.
